title: On Lipschitz Explosion in Deep Neural Networks with Normalization: Consequences for Optimization and Adversarial Robustness
abstract: arXiv:2611.08775v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Can a network look stable at every layer and still be exponentially unstable as a whole? The Lipschitz constant of a neural network is a basic stability quantity appearing in optimization guarantees, generalization bounds, and robustness certificates. Deep networks naturally admit two such notions, input Lipschitzness, measuring sensitivity to data perturbations, and parameter Lipschitzness, measuring sensitivity to weight perturbations. We prove that, for deep networks with normalization layers, with batch normalization as the canonical example, both Lipschitz constants can grow exponentially with depth and hence with parameter dimension, even under strong per-layer norm control such as $\|W_\ell\|_2\le 1$, and already for linear activations. translated_title: 关于带归一化层的深度神经网络中的Lipschitz爆炸：对优化与对抗鲁棒性的影响
translated_abstract: 一个网络是否可能在每一层看起来都稳定，但整体却呈指数级不稳定？神经网络的Lipschitz常数是出现在优化保证、泛化界和鲁棒性证书中的基本稳定性度量。深度网络自然存在两种这样的概念：输入Lipschitz性，衡量对数据扰动的敏感性；参数Lipschitz性，衡量对权重扰动的敏感性。我们证明，对于带归一化层的深度网络（以批归一化为典型例子），即使存在强逐层范数控制（如$\|W_\ell\|_2\le 1$），且仅在线性激活函数的情况下，两个Lipschitz常数都可以随深度（即参数维度）呈指数增长。因此，一种被广泛用于稳定训练的机制可能造成严重的最坏情况不稳定性，而这种不稳定性在局部是不可见的，即仅凭逐层范数界无法察觉。参数Lipschitz爆炸……
tldr: 本文证明了带归一化层的深度神经网络（如批归一化网络）的输入和参数Lipschitz常数即使在每个层的范数都受控的情况下，仍会随深度呈指数增长，这种逐层不可见的全局不稳定性对优化保证和对抗鲁棒性具有重要影响。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that the input and parameter Lipschitz constants of deep networks with normalization layers can grow exponentially with depth even under strong per-layer norm control, creating global instabilities invisible at the layer level, with significant consequences for optimization and adversarial robustness.
